name: RelHomClass.map_inf
initialProofState:
α : Type u_1
β : Type u_2
F : Type u_3
inst✝³ : SemilatticeInf α
inst✝² : LinearOrder β
inst✝¹ : FunLike F β α
inst✝ : RelHomClass F (fun x1 x2 => LT.lt x1 x2) fun x1 x2 => LT.lt x1 x2
a : F
m n : β
⊢ Eq (a (Min.min m n)) (Min.min (a m) (a n))
decl:
theorem map_inf [SemilatticeInf α] [LinearOrder β] [FunLike F β α]
    [RelHomClass F (· < ·) (· < ·)] (a : F) (m n : β) :
    a (m ⊓ n) = a m ⊓ a n :=
  (StrictMono.monotone fun _ _ => map_rel a).map_inf m n

name: RelHomClass.map_sup
initialProofState:

F : Type u_3

inst✝¹ : FunLike F β α

a : F

⊢ Eq (a (Max.max m n)) (Max.max (a m) (a n))
decl:
theorem map_sup [SemilatticeSup α] [LinearOrder β] [FunLike F β α]
    [RelHomClass F (· > ·) (· > ·)] (a : F) (m n : β) :
    a (m ⊔ n) = a m ⊔ a n :=
  map_inf (α := αᵒᵈ) (β := βᵒᵈ) _ _ _

name: Acc.of_subrel
initialProofState:
α : Type u_1
r : α → α → Prop
inst✝ : IsTrans α r
b : α
a : Subtype fun a => r a b
h : Acc (Subrel r (setOf fun a => r a b)) a
⊢ Acc r ↑a
decl:
theorem Acc.of_subrel {r : α → α → Prop} [IsTrans α r] {b : α} (a : { a // r a b })
    (h : Acc (Subrel r { a | r a b }) a) : Acc r a.1 :=
  h.recOn fun a _ IH ↦ ⟨_, fun _ hb ↦ IH ⟨_, _root_.trans hb a.2⟩ hb⟩

name: wellFounded_iff_wellFounded_subrel
initialProofState:
α : Type u_1
r : α → α → Prop
inst✝ : IsTrans α r
⊢ Iff (WellFounded r) (∀ (b : α), WellFounded (Subrel r (setOf fun a => r a b)))
decl:
/-- A relation `r` is well-founded iff every downward-interval `{ a | r a b }` of it is
well-founded. -/
theorem wellFounded_iff_wellFounded_subrel {r : α → α → Prop} [IsTrans α r] :
    WellFounded r ↔ ∀ b, WellFounded (Subrel r { a | r a b }) where
  mp h _ := InvImage.wf Subtype.val h
  mpr h := ⟨fun a ↦ ⟨_, fun b hr ↦ ((h a).apply _).of_subrel ⟨b, hr⟩⟩⟩
